respuesta.pregunta: In order-workflow-api 5.6.2-hotfix-1, when a "start work" message comes in to validate a pipeline, which BigQ topic does it arrive on, what does the service do next, and which fields does the Pipeline object it gets back have?
respuesta.respuesta:
The "start work" message arrives on the BigQ topic `batesting-orchestrator.order-orchestrator-api` and includes a Pipeline ID. When workflow-api receives it, it requests the full `Pipeline` information from the Orchestrator [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L18-L20].

The guide shows the `Pipeline` object as JSON with these fields: `merged`, `head_branch`, `base_branch`, `application_name`, `repository_name`, `pull_request_link`, `merge_commit`, `fork`, `head_commit`, `base_commit`, `pull_request`, `command_line`, `pull_request_number` and `user` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L22-L41]. The values in that JSON are only illustrations, so they don't tell you what the real values will be.

respuesta.pregunta: In order-workflow-api 5.6.2-hotfix-1, when the service gets a "start work" message to validate a pipeline, which BigQ topic does that message come from and what does the service do with it? Also, in the Pipeline object it works with, which fields hold the branch and commit information?
respuesta.respuesta:
The "start work" message comes from the BigQ topic `batesting-orchestrator.order-orchestrator-api` and contains a Pipeline ID. When workflow-api receives it, it fetches the full `Pipeline` information from the Orchestrator [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L18-L20].

The guide shows the `Pipeline` object as JSON [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L22-L23]. Two fields hold the branches: `head_branch` and `base_branch` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L27-L28]. Three fields hold the commits: `merge_commit` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L32], plus `head_commit` and `base_commit` [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/bigq.md:L34-L35]. The values in that JSON are only examples, such as the branch names and commit hashes. They are not real data.
